inputs.rig: art/characters/clone_01/motion/rig_002 (parts, rig-core, gait, proportions, webgl-character; files not modified)

method.projection: plane of the smoothed pelvis heading (circular mean, ±30 frames) viewed at an adjustable camera yaw: 0° = side view from the character's right, 90° = front; screen axis R = F·cosθ + L·sinθ; ground travel scaled by cosθ. Default 0°; the approved art is a 3/4 view, so the user is choosing the matching angle; vertical pitch φ (−60…+60°, + = looking down): screen up = height·cosφ − (depth toward camera)·sinφ; leg, arm and torso screen angles use it, physical heights (pelvis, clearance) do not. URL pitch=
method.scale: rig leg length (thigh 66 + shin 90 px) / BVH leg length (hip→knee→ankle) = 1.794 px/cm
method.pelvis: when a flat foot is planted, pelvis height is chosen so the FK leg (mocap angles, rig lengths) reaches that foot; otherwise BVH hip height × scale + rig ankle height; lowered only if an IK foot is out of reach; the reach-lowering is applied in proportion to each leg's IK weight
method.torso: Hips→Neck sagittal lean minus rest-pose lean, clamped ±0.3 rad, plus existing recoil term
method.feet: pitch from ankle→ball vector (3D horizontal length, toe-out compensated); heel pivot when dorsiflexed, toe pivot when plantarflexed; clearance = min(ankle, ball) height above ground; rig footPose geometry
method.foot_lock: contact = clearance < 1.5 cm, |pitch| < 0.35 rad and pivot world speed < 35 cm/s; heel/toe pivots blended over ±0.1 rad; offset ≤ 6 cm, released at 0.85/frame
method.legs: angle-based (2026-11-06 revision): sagittal thigh/shin angles from the mocap drive rig segments by FK (rig lengths 66/90 kept); during ground contact the angles blend toward the 2-bone IK solution to the locked foot; layer 0 (far) = Left, layer 1 (near) = Right
method.upper_body: existing CharacterRig weapon mount, grips and arm IK rigidly re-based onto the mocap torso (IK is invariant under rigid transforms)
method.blend: weight 1 on contact frames; ramps to 0 over 6 frames from frames with clearance < 1.5 cm; reduced by foot pitch 0.25→0.75 rad (toe roll follows FK because the rig boot is shorter than a human foot); FK that would sink the boot is re-solved by IK lifted to the floor
method.smoothing: foot pitch and torso lean ±2 frames; contact weights ±2 frames; pelvis height pre-fitted per frame and smoothed with a ±6-frame triangle; FK↔IK ramp 10 frames; soft IK in the last 3 px of leg extension (feet may stay up to ~1.1 px short)
method.match_mode: optional "뼈대 일치(비례 무시)": legs start at the projected hip joints and copy mocap thigh/shin angles (pure FK, no floor IK or foot lock); the whole body is shifted vertically so the lowest boot point touches the floor; arms copy mocap upper/fore arm angles (Right = front armA, Left = back armB); the rifle is carried by the front hand with its grip offset kept; the back hand may leave the rifle. URL match=1; boots: rotation and lengthwise scale are solved so the boot toe lands on the projected skeleton ankle→toe-end vector (exact whenever the projected foot is longer than the art ankle height; otherwise direction only); spine: the projected spine joints' forward/back offsets from the neck→hip line (5 samples, scaled to the rig torso length) warp the chest and inner-torso meshes; shoulders: arm roots placed at the projected mocap shoulder joints relative to the neck, scaled by rig/skeleton torso length (side view puts both shoulders ≈11 px under the neck, unlike the art-calibrated rig_002 offsets); torso: the projected hip→neck angle is used as is (no ±0.3 rad clamp, no rest-pose subtraction, unwrapped through full rotations, ±2-frame smoothing); grounding uses the lowest of boots, knees, hip, neck and head crown
method.proportion_mode: optional "뼈대 비율": thigh/shin and upper/fore arm lengths take the mocap skeleton ratios at the leg-length scale (100STYLE: legs 78.5/77.5 px instead of 66/90, arms 55.9/45.8 px instead of 43/38); limb sprites stretch to the segment length; torso, pelvis, head, boots and hands keep their art size; works with the default and the match mode; rifle grips are re-solved with the new arm lengths (0 px error). Knee angle accuracy is unchanged (mean 5.9° → 5.8°) because the angle-based retarget already absorbs the ratio. URL prop=1. Update: the same toggle also stretches the art to skeleton lengths — torso art and shoulder/mount offsets vertically by hip→neck / 77 px (100STYLE ×1.28, UAL ×1.40), head by neck→head-end / 47 px when a real head-end joint exists (100STYLE ×1.00), boots lengthwise by ankle→toe-end / rig ankle→toe (×2.9) with floor contact using the stretched boot; hands unchanged. Drawn by game/animation/mocap-renderer.js (subclass; rig_002 renderer unmodified)
method.live_lengths: optional "실시간 길이" (requires 뼈대 비율): segment lengths and art scales follow the per-frame projected skeleton lengths at the current view (thigh, shin, upper/fore arm per side, hip→neck torso, neck→head-end head, ankle→toe-end boot); pelvis fit precomputed for this key; screen fit uses the fixed clip proportions so the view does not pulse. URL live=1
method.head: optional "고개 따라가기" (default on): head and hair rotate about the neck pivot by the projected neck→head(-end) direction relative to the torso, zeroed at the clip's standing posture (median over frames with pelvis ≥ 90% of max and |lean| < 0.15 rad; whole-clip median otherwise) because BVH rest poses keep the head straight up while people look forward with ≈21° forward neck; clamped ±0.7 rad, smoothed ±2 frames; spring nods still add
method.debug: rig debug also draws hip → neck → crown and neck → both shoulders

known_limits: lateral (depth) motion is discarded; TR1 sidesteps/turns project with foreshortening
BVH foot (≈25 cm) is longer than the rig boot; contact uses heel/ball pivots, so toe placement is approximate
neutral walk arm swing is not used; arms stay on the rifle
pelvis rotation, head bob from mocap and knee depth ordering are not retargeted
not yet connected to a game scene or to rig-lab's own motion buttons
revision_reason: user reported the rig moving differently from the skeleton; diagnosis: thigh:shin ratio differs (human ≈1:1, rig 66:90 from the approved art) so ankle-position IK produced different knee angles (FW knee flex range 0–64° vs rig 9–49°, corr 0.65)

angle_match_after.remaining: toe-roll frames still bend ~10° less than mocap; swing foot reaches ~9 px further back because the rig shin is longer

causes: reach-lowering of the pelvis switched off when the lifting leg weight crossed 0.01 (3.5 px pelvis pop → 8 px knee jump on the nearly straight stance leg)
near-straight stance IK amplified 0.1 px distance changes into knee jumps
false contact while the landing foot was still sweeping forward (lock offset snapped to 6 cm)
heel/toe pivot switch with clamped projected foot length at large view angles
weight drop from 1 to 0.75 at toe-off

ual_walk_foot_pitch_second_difference_de.note: remaining kinks come from 30 fps source keys

foot_fit.reported: user: feet differ a lot from the skeleton
causes: art boot ankle→toe 15 px vs human 43 px at the same scale, ankle pivot 19.5 px above the sole vs ≈14 px
boot angle came from 3D foot pitch instead of the projected screen angle
a 2D boot cannot turn toward the camera

torso_match_fix.reported: user: torso completely different from the skeleton
causes: default-mode lean clamp ±0.3 rad applied in match mode
grounding only on boots (roll sank under the floor)
